name: Adults with a high-school credential
source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B15003, Monterey County row; underlying estimates are U.S. Census Bureau ACS
notes: ACS table B15003, universe population 25 years and over: total B15003001=280,853; diploma-or-higher categories B15003017–B15003025 sum to 206,180; 206,180 ÷ 280,853 × 100 = 73.412%, rounded to 73.4%. This replaces the prior QuickFacts 2020–24 estimate with a single-year 2024 ACS estimate. County/local Tier 1 searches did not produce a more recent countywide figure; Census Bureau API returned 503 and QuickFacts browser capture returned 403. Census Reporter is classified Tier 3, and the underlying Census table estimate remains identifiable.
